synthetic_telemetry.dataset: Enhanced Green AI Data Center Telemetry

caveats: The 100,000-row telemetry dataset is explicitly synthetic.
The sensor sessions are at different times and have different door states.
The supplied operational sensor logs cover only two hours per design.
No synchronized cooling energy meter and rack thermal data series are supplied for an energy-savings claim.
The paper's original 10,849-sample dataset is not included.
